questions.question: How do you get to Cavaryn?
questions.explanation: Right-click a Termite. If you sacrifice one in a Myrmite frame you get a portal that stays lit.

questions.question: Which frame makes a permanent Cavaryn portal?
questions.explanation: Myrmite. Nyxite is the Thoraxis one and Mossy Ouranwood is the Elythia one.

questions.question: What do Termites back away from?
questions.explanation: Torchlight. They eat wood too, so keep them far away from your house.

questions.question: What do Termites breed with?
questions.explanation: Wood. Which they'll also eat, so good luck.

questions.question: Which of these draws a horde's attention?
questions.explanation: Hanging around in one spot. Killing stuff and breaking eggs will do it too. Keep moving and things calm down.

questions.question: What usually arrives in a horde's last wave?
questions.explanation: Usually a Hercules Beetle. Big one.

questions.question: What pacifies an injured Hercules Beetle?
questions.explanation: Broodfruit. Feed it after the fight and it'll stick with you.

questions.question: What ores grow through Cavaryn's broodstone?
questions.explanation: Titanium and uranium. There's loads of it down there.
